_loader_notes: Warm-up and cool-down templates referenced by routine days through warmup_id and cooldown_id.
Each step is either timed (duration_seconds) or counted (reps). per_side means do both sides; for timed steps the duration is per side.
In the logger these appear as collapsible blocks at the top and bottom of the session, played with the timed player. One tap skips either block; skipping never affects the streak.

Ramp-up sets: after the warm-up, before the first main lift of the day, the logger adds two warm-up sets marked W: 8 reps at about 50% of today's working weight, then 5 reps at about 75%. Round to the nearest available weight. Skip for bodyweight and machine-assisted exercises. Ramp-up sets never count towards volume, PBs or awards.
Moves use the catalogue below. one_spot_alternative is offered automatically if she taps 'Busy?' or the machine is taken.
Draft for coach review before launch.

moves.name: Easy bike
moves.cue: Easy pace, you could chat comfortably.

moves.name: Easy cross-trainer
moves.cue: Easy pace, light resistance.

moves.name: March on the spot
moves.cue: Lift your knees and swing your arms.

moves.name: Cat-cow
moves.cue: On hands and knees, round then gently arch your back with your breath.

moves.name: World's greatest stretch
moves.cue: Step into a lunge, hand inside your front foot, then reach that arm to the ceiling.

moves.name: Bodyweight squat
moves.cue: Sit back and down, then stand tall. Smooth and easy.

moves.name: Glute bridge
moves.cue: Lie on your back, feet flat, lift your hips and squeeze.

moves.name: Leg swings, front to back
moves.cue: Hold something steady and swing one leg gently forwards and back.

moves.name: Leg swings, side to side
moves.cue: Face something steady and swing one leg across your body and out.

moves.name: Reverse lunge
moves.cue: Step back softly, lower your back knee, return.

moves.name: Standing hip circles
moves.cue: Lift one knee and draw a slow circle out to the side.

moves.name: Arm circles
moves.cue: Small circles growing bigger, forwards then backwards.

moves.name: Band pull-apart
moves.cue: Arms straight in front, pull the band apart to your chest.

moves.name: Wall angel
moves.cue: Back against a wall, slide your arms up and down like a snow angel.

moves.name: Open book
moves.cue: Lie on your side, knees bent, and open your top arm across to the other side.

moves.name: Inchworm
moves.cue: Fold forward, walk your hands out to a plank, then walk them back.

moves.name: Scapular push-up
moves.cue: In a plank, let your chest sink between your shoulder blades, then push away.

moves.name: Child's pose
moves.cue: Kneel, sit back on your heels and reach your arms forward. Breathe slowly.

moves.name: Figure four stretch
moves.cue: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the other knee and pull gently towards you.

moves.name: Lying hamstring stretch
moves.cue: Lie on your back and raise one straight leg, holding behind your thigh.

moves.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
moves.cue: Kneel on one knee, tuck your hips under and shift gently forward.

moves.name: Side-lying quad stretch
moves.cue: Lie on your side and pull your top heel towards your bottom.

moves.name: Calf stretch
moves.cue: Hands on a wall, one leg back with the heel down.

moves.name: Chest stretch
moves.cue: Forearm on a wall or upright, turn your body gently away.

moves.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
moves.cue: Pull one arm across your chest with the other.

moves.name: Overhead triceps stretch
moves.cue: Reach one hand down your back and gently press the elbow.

moves.name: Kneeling lat stretch
moves.cue: Kneel, place your hands on a bench and sink your chest down.

moves.name: Seated twist
moves.cue: Sit tall, cross one leg over and turn gently towards the bent knee.

moves.name: Slow breathing
moves.cue: Lie or sit comfortably. Breathe in for 4, out for 6.
